item.title: Where is it going wrong for Carrick's Man Utd?
item.description: Thursday marks five months exactly since Man Utd announced Michael Carrick would be staying on as head coach. There will be little mood for celebrating anniversaries the morning after his worst night in the role.
item.content:encoded: Thursday marks five months exactly since Man Utd announced Michael Carrick would be staying on as head coach. There will be little mood for celebrating anniversaries the morning after his worst night in the role.

item.title: Kylian Mbappe makes feelings clear on Barcelona clash after Real Madrid win
item.description: Kylian Mbappe makes feelings clear on Barcelona clash after Real Madrid win Real Madrid made it three wins from three games as they defeated RB Leipzig in their latest UEFA Champions League game at the Santiago Bernabeu last night. With this win, the Merengues have climbed to the fourth position on the League Phase table. While Los Blancos maintained their winning run, the forward Kylian Mbappe also kept up his scoring run in the competition. After scoring in the games against Inter Milan and AS Roma, he again got on the scoresheet, as he scored a beautiful goal to take the scoreline to 3-0 in favor of his team. As MARCA has reported, the Frenchman also spoke to the media after the match. The Real Madrid star highlighted how important this win can be for his team: “Every point is important for finishing in the top eight, and this is an important victory.” When asked if he was feeling confident about facing Barcelona, Mbappe assured that he was focused on the last night’s game: “We’ve only been thinking about Leipzig.” The forward wanted to continue pleasing the fans with his performances: “The Bernabéu wants us to score goals and play attacking football, and we want to please the fans. We try to bring them joy. ” Meanwhile, he was also looking to help his team win with these goals: “I’m fine. I have to score goals, help the team and make sure we win.” The Frenchman also had some words of encouragement for Vinicius Junior, who was visibly sad after another underwhelming performance: “If he’s sad, it’s because it means he wants to give a lot to the team and the fans. He should be proud of who he is.” Going forward, Kylian Mbappe will be facing an FC Barcelona side against whom he has particularly enjoyed scoring. Hopefully, he will be able to add a few goals in this Sunday’s El Clasico, and will be able to help his team get a win against the Blaugranes.

item.title: Libya recovers Swiss, Austrian women kidnapped since 2025 in Niger
item.description: Two women — one Swiss and the other Austrian — were released from more than a year of captivity in Niger and arrived in Libya’s eastern city of Benghazi, Libyan media outlets reported on Thursday. The two women — Swiss national Eva Gretzmacher, 76, and Austrian Claudia Abbt, 69 — were abducted in Niger in 2025. In a video released by Libya’s eastern-based al-Masar TV, the women appeared emaciated and thanked the country’s eastern-based military commander Khalifa Haftar and his son, Saddam, for their release. Al-Masar said “two hostages, an Austrian and a Swiss national, have been freed after being held captive in Niger for a year and a half”. “My name is Eva Gretzmacher, I am 76, and I thank from the bottom of my heart Marshal Haftar and his son, Saddam, who released us,” one of the woman said in French. “I had been held hostage for a year and nine months,” she said. Abbt said she was “happy to be free”, also thanking Haftar. Online website Libyan News Observatory also reported their release. Libya has struggled to recover from the chaos that followed the 2011 NATO-backed uprising that toppled longtime ruler Muammar Gaddafi. Two governments are currently vying for power: a UN-recognised administration in Tripoli led by Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah and its rival in the east backed by Haftar. AFP The post Libya recovers Swiss, Austrian women kidnapped since 2025 in Niger appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Bruno Fernandes turning on Michael Carrick exposes Man United’s unavoidable truth
item.description: Great, now the parents are arguing. It was pretty clear when Bruno Fernandes was hauled off in the 65th minute with Manchester United being thumped by Como in the Champions League that he was far from happy. He had spent his evening attempting to lead the United press, forlornly chasing after the ball like a terrier who had been tasked with closing down a flock of pigeons in a vast town square. Fernandes, like his United team-mates, got nowhere near it and Como toyed with them. Before his substitution for Joshua Zirkzee, a further white flag on a horrid evening for United, the captain had also wasted his energy by performatively flapping his arms, looking over his shoulder with the exasperated expression of ‘what are you guys doing back there?’ He trudged around the side of the pitch and returned to the bench without acknowledging his manager. And look, Fernandes is not exactly meant to be alright to be once again caught at the scene of a chastening night for United, their joint-heaviest defeat in the Champions League or something like that. But nor did we expect Fernandes to come out so strongly in his criticism at full-time . “It's a decision from the staff to not press man to man and sometimes leave space behind and try to get the ball, but sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confidence," Fernandes said. Asked whether Carrick got his tactics wrong, Fernandes replied: “That's on the manager and staff to see it, not me. Sometimes you have to be more brave under pressure, take the risk of pressing high and making them uncomfortable.” Fernandes questioned his manager’s tactics after the heavy defeat to Como (PA Wire) Carrick appeared bemused, but there was an end-of-days look to United’s defeat and an end-of-days feel to the way Carrick put on a brave face and marched over the remaining United fans in Como to apologise at full-time. It was a gesture that, as the cycle of the United circus continues to spin, had striking similarities to Ole Gunnar Solskjaer holding his hands up to the United fans just days before he was sacked following the 4-1 defeat at Watford five years ago . A proud and respected former player left hurting by the decline at Old Trafford? It’s happening again, and everyone appears to have accepted Carrick’s days are numbered. Perhaps the surest sign of that is not just Fernandes rounding on his manager but Carrick actually saying something interesting in his response when asked about his captain’s comments. “There's a little bit of whatever system you play, whatever tactics you play, if you don't run, and you don't run forward, and you don't run back, you aren’t going to win,” replied said, pointedly. But it has taken less than 150 days since the end of last season for disharmony to fester and the cracks in the dressing room to show. item.content:encoded: Great, now the parents are arguing. It was pretty clear when Bruno Fernandes was hauled off in the 65th minute with Manchester United being thumped by Como in the Champions League that he was far from happy. Fernandes, like his United team-mates, got nowhere near it and Como toyed with them. Before his substitution for Joshua Zirkzee, a further white flag on a horrid evening for United, the captain had also wasted his energy by performatively flapping his arms, looking over his shoulder with the exasperated expression of ‘what are you guys doing back there?’ He trudged around the side of the pitch and returned to the bench without acknowledging his manager. And look, Fernandes is not exactly meant to be alright to be once again caught at the scene of a chastening night for United, their joint-heaviest defeat in the Champions League or something like that. But nor did we expect Fernandes to come out so strongly in his criticism at full-time . “It's a decision from the staff to not press man to man and sometimes leave space behind and try to get the ball, but sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confidence," Fernandes said. Asked whether Carrick got his tactics wrong, Fernandes replied: “That's on the manager and staff to see it, not me. Sometimes you have to be more brave under pressure, take the risk of pressing high and making them uncomfortable.” Fernandes questioned his manager’s tactics after the heavy defeat to Como (PA Wire) Carrick appeared bemused, but there was an end-of-days look to United’s defeat and an end-of-days feel to the way Carrick put on a brave face and marched over the remaining United fans in Como to apologise at full-time. It was a gesture that, as the cycle of the United circus continues to spin, had striking similarities to Ole Gunnar Solskjaer holding his hands up to the United fans just days before he was sacked following the 4-1 defeat at Watford five years ago . A proud and respected former player left hurting by the decline at Old Trafford? It’s happening again, and everyone appears to have accepted Carrick’s days are numbered. Perhaps the surest sign of that is not just Fernandes rounding on his manager but Carrick actually saying something interesting in his response when asked about his captain’s comments. “There's a little bit of whatever system you play, whatever tactics you play, if you don't run, and you don't run forward, and you don't run back, you aren’t going to win,” replied said, pointedly. But it has taken less than 150 days since the end of last season for disharmony to fester and the cracks in the dressing room to show. Carrick took over from the dismal reign of Ruben Amorim in January and inspired United's finishing third in the Premier League . The transformation of their form led to Fernandes finishing being named as the country’s player of the year. But United are now seven games without a win. Fernandes looks exhausted to be playing three times a week, as a result of their qualification for the Champions League. You could say Fernandes is genuinely hurt at how quickly things have unravelled, again. He has turned 32 this season and the majority of his United career has played out in this lingering sense of doom. But there was optimism heading into the summer after finishing third and Carrick laying the foundations; it is not his fault, or Carrick’s, that United appear to have messed up their midfield rebuild and failed to sign a left back or a back-up striker in the summer, which is the reason that Fernandes has been once again shifted out of his preferred No 10 position. Carrick apologised to the United fans for an ‘unacceptable’ performance in Italy (Getty) But it is significant that the Portuguese has rounded upon Carrick in the same manner of Lisandro Martinez ’s explosive criticism of Jason Wilcox a week ago . Martinez took the extraordinary step of criticising those upstairs and singling out United’s technical director for not backing Carrick in the transfer market. Martinez’s rant struck a chord with the United support, but he was still swiftly frog-marched into a Carrington office for a meeting with Wilcox, CEO Omar Berrada, and Carrick before apologising. Carrick hailed a “fresh start” after the 1-1 draw at Leeds on Sunday . He insisted, only last Friday, that his players had their best training session under him. But that facade of a harmonious camp has unravelled as quickly as this disjointed United side and morale is on the floor. Fernandes has reverted, quite stunningly, really, from last season's talisman to the demonstrative, moaning figurehead, whose this-is-all-quite-crap energy appears to be incredibly unhelpful in a time of crisis. And of course the roots of United’s permacrisis run much deeper than Carrick, as Martinez alluded to last week in Madrid. Like his Argentinian team-mate, Fernandes could have come out and criticised the United owners and their hierarchy and torched the decisions and processes that have led to the club’s worst start to a season since 1986. But Martinez tried that last week and it was like shouting into the wind. Instead, Fernandes chose to expose what appears to be division in a fractured dressing room, and even Carrick appeared resigned into accepting there’s no coming back from that.

item.title: Websites down: what is PHP and how has it raised AI hacking fears?
item.description: Artificial intelligence has found critical security flaws in a major programming language called PHP, with many websites taken offline Thursday as organisations worldwide scramble to fend off would-be hackers. As AI’s fast-advancing capabilities fuel concern over the increased risk of cyberattacks, here are some questions and answers about the situation: What is PHP and how widely used is it? Created in the early 1990s, PHP is a computer programming language that helps run an estimated 70 percent of the world’s websites. It is “a backbone of the web”, according to security firm Wiz Research, which says it used AI to find vulnerabilities hidden in PHP for more than a decade. PHP — a name that originally stood for Personal Home Page — underpins popular web design platforms, meaning the flaws could allow hackers to break into various sites, from online stores to government services. A fix was released Wednesday, with the PHP Foundation telling the tech departments of companies and organisations around the world: “If you run PHP, it is imperative that you update now.” That has resulted in a slew of apps and websites — from the Paris police website to a Pokemon sleep tracker — going dark as developers work to protect their underlying code from hacks. How did AI find the flaws? Cutting-edge AI models, such as those from US giants OpenAI and Google, were used by Wiz and other groups to uncover PHP’s weak spots in August. This was kept under wraps while a fix was developed. OpenAI called the flaws “one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory”, adding that it “marks a new phase, where AI can find security bugs with internet-scale impact”. Separately to Wiz, security firm Calif found the flaws as part of an OpenAI-funded audit of PHP’s code. “The trouble with tools like AI is that the moment all the information’s out there, people can weaponise it very, very quickly,” Steve Kerrison, senior lecturer in cybersecurity at the Singapore campus of James Cook University, told AFP. “That’s why everybody’s acting with such urgency to respond to this issue.” Have sites already been hacked? “Taking websites offline does not necessarily mean they have been hacked. It can be a responsible measure to protect systems while security updates are applied,” said Dimitrios Salampasis from Australia’s Swinburne University of Technology. So far “the evidence that security researchers are seeing is that nobody was actively performing attacks using the techniques available”, Kerrison said. Larger institutions, from government agencies to news outlets, should be able to fix their websites relatively quickly — but others may be left vulnerable. “There are sites, systems and people out there who will have no idea about this and still won’t for days, weeks and months,” Kerrison warned. item.content:encoded: Artificial intelligence has found critical security flaws in a major programming language called PHP, with many websites taken offline Thursday as organisations worldwide scramble to fend off would-be hackers. As AI’s fast-advancing capabilities fuel concern over the increased risk of cyberattacks, here are some questions and answers about the situation: What is PHP and how widely used is it? Created in the early 1990s, PHP is a computer programming language that helps run an estimated 70 percent of the world’s websites. It is “a backbone of the web”, according to security firm Wiz Research, which says it used AI to find vulnerabilities hidden in PHP for more than a decade. PHP — a name that originally stood for Personal Home Page — underpins popular web design platforms, meaning the flaws could allow hackers to break into various sites, from online stores to government services. A fix was released Wednesday, with the PHP Foundation telling the tech departments of companies and organisations around the world: “If you run PHP, it is imperative that you update now.” That has resulted in a slew of apps and websites — from the Paris police website to a Pokemon sleep tracker — going dark as developers work to protect their underlying code from hacks. How did AI find the flaws? Cutting-edge AI models, such as those from US giants OpenAI and Google, were used by Wiz and other groups to uncover PHP’s weak spots in August. This was kept under wraps while a fix was developed. OpenAI called the flaws “one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory”, adding that it “marks a new phase, where AI can find security bugs with internet-scale impact”. Separately to Wiz, security firm Calif found the flaws as part of an OpenAI-funded audit of PHP’s code. “The trouble with tools like AI is that the moment all the information’s out there, people can weaponise it very, very quickly,” Steve Kerrison, senior lecturer in cybersecurity at the Singapore campus of James Cook University, told AFP. “That’s why everybody’s acting with such urgency to respond to this issue.” Have sites already been hacked? “Taking websites offline does not necessarily mean they have been hacked. It can be a responsible measure to protect systems while security updates are applied,” said Dimitrios Salampasis from Australia’s Swinburne University of Technology. So far “the evidence that security researchers are seeing is that nobody was actively performing attacks using the techniques available”, Kerrison said. Larger institutions, from government agencies to news outlets, should be able to fix their websites relatively quickly — but others may be left vulnerable. “There are sites, systems and people out there who will have no idea about this and still won’t for days, weeks and months,” Kerrison warned. That may include user-run blogs that could be used to spread computer viruses, spam people or distribute malicious content. Could there be other consequences? A data breach could affect customers in the future if their personal information is used in so-called “phishing” attacks, where someone is tricked into revealing their password to an online service. The complex and interlinked nature of online systems, which often use third-party interfaces, means some vulnerabilities could remain even after the problem is fixed. If the third parties use PHP, “then even though you patched yourself… you’re still unsecure”, said Rahat Masood, senior lecturer in cyber security at the University of New South Wales, Sydney. PHP isn’t everything, however — strong cybersecurity measures should include several layers of defences, Kerrison said. item.title: Europa League: Juventus vs. Rennes – probable line-ups, where to watch on TV
item.description: Europa League: Juventus vs. Rennes – probable line-ups, where to watch on TV Randal Kolo Muani and Nick Woltemade will start together for the first time in the Juventus attack as the Bianconeri host Rennes at the Allianz Stadium in the Europa League Round 3. It kicks off at 18:45 CET [17:45 BST] at the Allianz Stadium in Turin. The Bianconeri have already won the opening two Europa League games in the league phase, but want to bounce back after a 3-0 home loss against Lazio in Serie A last Sunday. TURIN, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Kolo Muani of Juventus in action against Nuno Tavares of SS Lazio during the Serie A match between Juventus and SS Lazio at Allianz Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) The Old Lady’s coach Luciano Spalletti confirmed on Wednesday that Kolo Muani and Woltemade would start together for the first time today. Spalletti is still dealing with a selection crisis, with Francisco Conceiçao, Kenan Yildiz, Manuel Locatelli, Khephren Thuram, Kamil Grabara and Jeff Ekhator injured. Edon Zhegrova, Daniele Rugani and Arkadiusz Milik are also unavailable because they are not on the Bianconeri’s UEFA list. TURIN, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Nick Woltemade of Juventus runs with the ball under pressure from Reda Belahyane of S.S. Lazio during the Serie A match between Juventus and SS Lazio at Allianz Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Chris Ricco/Getty Images) According to multiple sources, including Tuttosport, Gazzetta and Sky , Gleison Bremer will start at the back, joined by Federico Gatti and Lloyd Kelly. There’s doubt on the right flank over whether Pierre Kalulu or Zeki Celik will start, while Andrea Cambiaso is expected to play as a left midfielder. Douglas Luiz and Pape Matar Sarr will compete for a starting spot in central midfield alongside Teun Koopmeiners. Juventus vs. Rennes – where to watch on TV The match is available on TNT Sports 5, HBO Max, and NOW TV in the UK and Ireland, and on CBS Sports Network, Paramount+, fuboTV, TUDN USA, TUDN.com, the TUDN App, and ViX in the USA. Football Italia will provide live updates via a live blog with Bournemouth-Milan and Ajax-Atalanta (Conference League) to follow at 21:00 CET. Juventus vs. Rennes – probable line-ups Juventus (3-4-1-2): Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Kelly; Kalulu, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Celik; McKennie; Woltemade, Kolo Muani. Rennes (3-5-2): Samba; Ait Boudlal, Cresswell, Rouault; Reynolds; Szymanski, Rongier, M. Camara, Nagida; Dia, Al-Taamari.

item.title: Crystal Palace XI vs Besiktas – Predicted lineup and team news
item.description: Crystal Palace XI vs Besiktas – Predicted lineup and team news Crystal Palace will be aiming to recover from their slim Europa League losses when they travel to Turkey to take on Besiktas on Thursday at the Tupras Stadyumu. The Eagles arrive for this European fixture in a difficult spell after a run of disappointing displays. They were beaten heavily 5-0 by rivals Brighton in their most recent match, exposing major problems in a defence that is already short of players. With Pierre Sage’s team lacking rhythm and belief both at home and in Europe, they are under serious pressure to regain stability and improve defensively. Crystal Palace team news Palace head into the game with a major lack of defensive options for Sage. Chadi Riad is still sidelined with a knee injury, while Dean Henderson, Ben Chilwell, and Takehiro Tomiyasu were all absent against Brighton and remain unavailable. Axel Disasi is back after serving a domestic ban and should lead a temporary back three, joined by Jaydee Canvot and Chris Richards in front of goalkeeper Walter Benítez. Further forward, Sage can call on Mingueza, Mitchell, Timber, and Wharton across the midfield and wide areas. Yeremy Pino and Ismaïla Sarr are expected to provide width and support Jørgen Strand Larsen through the middle. Jean-Philippe Mateta and Daichi Kamada are also realistic alternatives as Sage decides on his strongest attacking setup. Crystal Palace predicted lineup Possible starting XI: Henderson; Canvot, Disasi, Richards; Mingueza, Timber, Wharton, Mitchell; Pino, Sarr; Strand Larsen When will the match kick off? The match will kick off at 8pm BST on Thursday, 23rd October. How to watch Besiktas vs Crystal Palace? The match will be shown live on TNT Sports 2 for UK fans. item.title: Wrong anthems played at Asian Para Games after mishap-marred Asian Games
item.description: The Asian Games closed on October 4 (MOHD RASFAN) Wrong national anthems were played three times at the Asian Para Games in Japan's Nagoya this week, prompting the mayor to apologise just days after the city hosted the mishap-plagued Asian Games. The Asian Para Games is taking place in the central Japanese hub city through Saturday, featuring around 4,000 athletes and officials in 18 sports. Nagoya Mayor Ichiro Hirosawa apologised on Wednesday for the latest error, which occurred despite officials' pledges to implement steps to prevent mistakes, including playing the correct national anthems. "These things happened during the Asian Games, so of course the operations were reviewed and examined based on the lessons learned. The fact that it happened again is really just unacceptable," the mayor told a press conference. On Monday, a Taiwanese athlete won a men's para taekwondo competition, but the Iranian anthem was played in its entirety, according to Nagoya officials at the mayor's press conference. Officials realised their mistake after the ceremony, they said. On the same day, the Iranian anthem was played again during a women's para taekwondo ceremony, where a Mongolian competitor was receiving the gold medal, according to the city. The incorrect music was stopped after the Mongolian delegation pointed out the error. Organisers then played the Mongolian anthem after the music was provided by the delegation, Nagoya officials said. Separately on Monday, officials broadcast the South Korean anthem for about five seconds, instead of the Chinese one, before a sitting volleyball match between China and Iran. "It is unacceptable, or rather, it's painful. I am very sorry about it," the mayor said, adding that he felt the tournament was otherwise progressing smoothly. The Asian Games, which concluded in early October, faced heavy criticism for shortcomings ranging from inadequate accommodation for athletes to the playing of wrong national anthems. On September 18, organisers played North Korea's national anthem for the South Korean hockey team. hih/hol

item.title: Besiktas vs Crystal Palace – Match preview and team news
item.description: Besiktas vs Crystal Palace – Match preview and team news Crystal Palace will look to bounce back from their narrow defeats in the Europa League last time out when they face Besiktas away from home on Thursday at the Tupras Stadyumu. Besiktas vs Crystal Palace – Match preview and team news Date: Thursday, 23rd October. Kick-off: 8pm BST. Venue: Tupras Stadyumu, Istanbul. Besiktas team news Besiktas faces notable selection challenges ahead of their Europa League clash under head coach Vincenzo Italiano. The Turkish side will definitely be missing club captain Orkun Kökçü, who remains sidelined with a foot and heel injury sustained during their previous European fixture against Hoffenheim. Adding to their woes, winger Milot Rashica is completely ruled out of the contest due to a persistent thigh and hamstring muscle injury. On a positive note, former Juventus striker Dušan Vlahović is back in contention after recovering from the illness that kept him out of the Hoffenheim victory. Vlahović is expected to battle Oh Hyeon-gyu to lead the frontline, while Leandro Trossard is heavily tipped to start on the left wing. Despite Kökçü being named in some projected lineups alongside Nübel, Murillo, Agbadou, and Topcu, his official absence means Italiano must engineer a late tactical adjustment in midfield. Crystal Palace team news Crystal Palace enters the fixture plagued by a severe defensive shortage for manager Pierre Sage. The Eagles remain without long-term absentee Chadi Riad due to a knee injury. Furthermore, key defensive figures Dean Henderson, Ben Chilwell, and Takehiro Tomiyasu all missed the recent Brighton match and remain entirely unavailable for selection. To steady the backline, Axel Disasi returns from a domestic suspension and is expected to anchor a makeshift back three alongside young Jaydee Canvot and Chris Richards, shielding goalkeeper Walter Benítez. Further up the pitch, Sage has options with Mingueza, Mitchell, Timber, and Wharton anchoring the wider positions. In the attacking third, Yeremy Pino and Ismaïla Sarr are highly likely to feature out wide to support central forward Jørgen Strand Larsen, though Jean-Philippe Mateta and Daichi Kamada also remain firmly in the structural conversation for the final starting eleven. Form Besiktas is experiencing a turbulent run of form across all competitions. The Turkish side is looking to bounce back immediately after suffering a disappointing 2-0 domestic defeat against Trabzonspor over the weekend. Prior to that setback, Vincenzo Italiano’s squad secured a morale-boosting victory against Hoffenheim in their previous European fixture. They will need to rediscover that continental sharpness to overcome their recent domestic inconsistency and steady their group-stage campaign. Crystal Palace Crystal Palace enters this European clash in a state of crisis following a string of poor performances. item.title: Real Madrid president Florentino Perez will not travel to Barcelona for El Clasico
item.description: Real Madrid president Florentino Perez will not travel to Barcelona for El Clasico Real Madrid president Florentino Perez will not travel to Barcelona for Sunday’s El Clasico at Spotify Camp Nou, according to Mundo Deportivo , meaning the Spanish giants will contest one of football’s biggest fixtures without a meeting between the two clubs’ presidents. The traditional pre-match lunch involving the Barcelona and Real Madrid boards will also not take place, which continues to show the massive breakdown in relations between the rivals. Real Madrid will maintain a presence at Camp Nou Perez’s decision not to attend means there will be no presidential reunion with Barcelona counterpart Joan Laporta before kick-off. However, it is crucial to note that a Real Madrid delegate is expected to represent the club in the VIP area, ensuring that the club will still have an official presence at the stadium. Florentino Perez will not attend the El Clasico at Spotify Camp Nou. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) There is precedent for a reduced Madrid delegation. At the previous corresponding Clasico at Camp Nou, Real Madrid honorary president Pirri was the club’s sole representative in the VIP box. The expected attendance of a new delegate this time would again leave Perez away from the occasion. For Real Madrid, the priority is the match itself, as the president’s absence does not alter the sporting challenge facing the team, although it will attract attention given the significance of the rivalry and the current state of relations between the two institutions. Negreira dispute continues to affect relations with Barcelona The lack of a directors’ lunch shows the declining institutional relationship between the two that has developed since Real Madrid became involved in the Negreira case . There is no relationship between Real Madrid and Barcelona. (Photo by LLUIS GENE/AFP via Getty Images) The dispute has contributed to the deterioration in relations between the clubs , with the traditional pre-match gathering between their leadership teams no longer taking place. Perez has also been absent from Camp Nou in recent seasons, making his latest decision consistent with that pattern. The lack of direct engagement between the presidents means there is little indication of an immediate return to the previous level of cooperation between the clubs. Indeed, the situation remains separate from the footballing contest, but it illustrates how the rivalry has extended beyond the pitch into the boardroom.

item.title: Champions League Team of the Week: Our Best XI
item.description: Champions League Team of the Week: Our Best XI The Champions League delivered another week of drama, statement victories and individual brilliance, with established superstars and emerging talents alike making their mark on Europe's biggest stage. From Phil Foden 's clinical hat-trick to Nico Paz 's sensational display for Como, there were performances that demanded recognition. Here is our Champions League Team of the Week, featuring the standout performers from another memorable round of European action. Goalkeeper: Yann Sommer - Club Brugge Club Brugge's 3-0 win over Lens looked like a comfortable result on paper, in large part thanks to Yann Sommer. The veteran made a string of saves to deny the French side, who created six big chances without scoring. Right-back: Federico Valverde - Real Madrid Influential at both ends as Real Madrid made light work of Leipzig at the Bernabeu. Valverde led the contest for touches (116), made three key passes, five clearances, and four tackles on a characteristically all-action night. Centre-back: Jacobo Ramon - Como Expect the queue of clubs interested in Jacobo Ramon to get a little longer. A standout showing against Manchester United saw the Spanish centre-back lead the game for touches (103) and make a whopping 12 line-breaking passes. Late on, he ghosted forward to head home the fourth goal of an unforgettable win. Centre-back: Natan - Real Betis Real Betis maintained their 100% record in the Champions League this season with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Feyenoord. The Spanish side are back in this competition for the first time since 2005/06 and are making an impression. Natan led the side to a clean sheet, with 18 defensive actions, nine clearances, and just one misplaced pass. Left-back: Carlos Augusto - Inter Milan A brilliant breakaway goal from Carlos Augusto earned Inter a 1-0 win over Shakhtar Donetsk, as the Italian champions recovered from Alessandro Bastoni's red card to win. Augusto became just the third Inter defender to score in consecutive Champions League appearances, after Giacinto Facchetti in 1967 and Denzel Dumfries in 2025. Midfield: Vitinha - Paris Saint-Germain The conductor of the best side in Europe. PSG will take some stopping in the chase for Champions League success, as the champions target a third straight crown. Vitinha was at his elusive best against Barcelona and capped a fine performance with a stunning goal. Midfield: Phil Foden - Manchester City How good is it to see Phil Foden back enjoying his football? One of the most watchable talents in the Premier League has had a tough time of late, but this was Foden back at his best. A clinical hat-trick helped Manchester City cruised past AEK Athens and bodes well for Enzo Maresca's in-form side. An outstanding showing from Paz, who became the youngest Argentinian player (22 years, 43 days) to be involved in three goals (2 goals, 1 assist) in a Champions League game since Messi in 2009. The teenager tore Villarreal apart in a coming-of-age performance at Anfield, with Ngumoha dangerous on either wing and ruthless in the final third. Desire Doue was the star of the show for PSG, opening the scoring with a strike from outside the box before later assisting Lucas Hernandez from a corner. Forward: Harry Kane - Bayern Munich Has a good a chance as anyone of taking the Ballon d'Or next week. Kane cut apart Arsenal with an exquisite pass for Alphonso Davies' equaliser, before scoring the second from the spot to continue his fine record against the Gunners.

item.title: Liverpool's next transfer is obvious, Fabrizio Romano confirms it
item.description: Liverpool's next transfer is obvious, Fabrizio Romano confirms it Liverpool spent over £150 million on new players in the summer. In a normal season, this would allow Liverpool to add many new faces to their ranks but, this time around, only four were brought. In fact, the deal for Jeremy Jacquet was completed in January 2026 so, his transfer fee can't even be counted towards the total amount they spent. And, while Jacquet, Ronald Araujo, Victor Munoz and Bradley Barcola have all had a positive impact on Liverpool since joining, there are still some positions among their ranks that could do with an upgrade or two. This has been made clear for a while now but, since the Reds don't have an endless money pit like some of their rivals, it's unclear whether the transfers they need to make will actually be completed in January. But, fortunately for the Reds' fanbase, some transfers do seem to be on the horizon. Fabrizio Romano admits that Liverpool's search for a new midfielder is becoming 'intense' Fabrizio Romano is the transfer guru. The Italian journalist was the first to break the news of Araujo joining Liverpool and, aside from his 'here we go' on Marc Guehi last season, his news about Liverpool has often been fairly accurate. Whether its about a change of manager or a player exiting/joining, Romano has often been on point. So, the fact that he's now said conversations about Liverpool signing a new midfielder have become 'intense' could mean that a January deal for one is on the way. "Conversations on midfielders are becoming very very intense at Liverpool. We’ll have to wait and see whether it will be for January or the summer," he said via his YouTube channel . "Lamine Camara and Alex Scott are appreciated." Liverpool must do everything they can to sign a new midfielder soon At the moment, Liverpool have four central midfielders among their ranks. Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister are Iraola's two preferred options at the moment but, with Szoboszlai now out of action for who knows how long, others such as Ryan Gravenberch and even Trey Nyoni may be given a more regular role. And, as well as Nyoni has played this season, relying on him to be a regular starter at just 19 years old feels a tad unfair. So, signing a new central midfielder such as Alex Scott, Adam Wharton or Lamine Camara should be one of their top priorities . Because, not only would it help improve their standing but, it could also help them get back to their best, especially since squad depth was one of their main issues last term. For now, everything is still up in the air but, with Romano saying that things have become "intense" at Liverpool regarding their search for a midfielder, it certainly feels like a new number six is on the top of Julian Ward's agenda.

item.title: Ebola: UN expresses confidence in Nigeria’s containment efforts
item.description: The United Nations has expressed confidence in Nigeria’s capacity to contain its newly confirmed Ebola case, pledging support to prevent further spread of the deadly disease. UN Secretary-General’s Spokesperson, Stéphane Dujarric, gave the assurance on Wednesday while responding to questions from the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) at the UN Headquarters in New York. Dujarric said the UN was concerned about the detection of the Ebola Bundibugyo virus in Nigeria, the fifth country to report a case during the current outbreak. However, he expressed confidence in Nigeria’s health authorities, commending their swift response and extensive contact-tracing efforts following the confirmation. “We have full confidence in the ability and the capacity of the Nigerian Government’s health authorities to deal with this single case,” he said. The spokesperson acknowledged that the appearance of the virus in another country raised concerns about its potential spread beyond countries already affected. “Yeah, I mean, it’s of course concerning that there is a case in a new country,” Dujarric said. He, however, noted that Nigerian authorities had already undertaken active contact tracing to identify and monitor people potentially exposed to the infected patient. Asked by NAN whether the UN was worried that the outbreak could spread to additional countries or persist for another year, Dujarric emphasised international cooperation. He urged countries to comply with international health regulations and collaborate closely with the World Health Organisation (WHO) to contain the outbreak. “It is also incumbent that countries work together, follow international health regulations, work with the WHO,” he said. The spokesperson stressed that WHO was established to support countries in confronting precisely such international public health emergencies. “This is why the WHO was created, to help to deal with these issues, and I know they’re very much on top of it,” he added. Responding to NAN’s question about assistance being provided to Nigeria, Dujarric reaffirmed the UN’s readiness to support the Federal Government. “We are, as always, ready to assist the Government of Nigeria in any way possible,” he declared. He also expressed confidence that WHO officials in Nigeria were maintaining direct contact with national health authorities to coordinate appropriate responses. The UN assurance followed Nigeria’s confirmation on Tuesday of an imported Ebola Bundibugyo case involving a woman with a recent travel history to Uganda. According to WHO, the patient developed symptoms on Oct. 7, sought medical attention in Abuja on Oct. 11 and tested positive for the virus on Oct. 20. The UN health agency said the patient was receiving treatment in isolation, while Nigerian authorities had identified 44 contacts for monitoring and further investigation. The case comes amid an outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in May and subsequently spread internationally, raising concerns about cross-border transmission. WHO’s latest situation report recorded 9,637 confirmed infections and 4,646 deaths in the DRC as of Oct. 19, underscoring the seriousness of the regional health emergency. (NAN) The post Ebola: UN expresses confidence in Nigeria’s containment efforts appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Nagelsmann emerges as leading candidate to replace Carrick amid Man United crisis
item.description: Nagelsmann emerges as leading candidate to replace Carrick amid Man United crisis Michael Carrick is under huge pressure as Manchester United coach after a 4-1 defeat to Como in the Champions League on Wednesday extended the Red Devils’ winless run to seven games. According to talkSPORT, Manchester United are seemingly already preparing for life without Carrick and have identified former Bayern Munich and Germany coach Julian Nagelsmann as their leading candidate to replace him. The 39-year-old, who left his role as Germany boss following a disappointing World Cup, was linked with the job before Carrick was appointed permanently in May and is understood to have admirers within the club’s hierarchy. Another German coach, Brighton & Hove Albion boss Fabian Hürzeler, is also being mentioned as a candidate, alongside Antonio Conte and Eddie Howe.

Another German coach, Brighton & Hove Albion boss Fabian Hürzeler, is also being mentioned as a candidate, alongside Antonio Conte and Eddie Howe.

item.title: Warriors’ Draymond Green weighs in on Yaxel Lendeborg-Luka Doncic flare-up
item.description: Rob Gray-Imagn Images Warriors’ Draymond Green weighs in on Yaxel Lendeborg-Luka Doncic flare-up appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Golden State Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg did not hold back his frustration toward Los Angeles Lakers superstar Luka Doncic during his debut game. The two players were seen exchanging words on the court . However, Warriors veteran Draymond Green stood firmly behind his rookie teammate and defended his decision to challenge the Slovenian star. When asked about the heated exchange between Lendeborg and Doncic in the locker room, Green expressed his support for the rookie and dismissed the idea that he should have avoided confronting an established NBA superstar. “Everybody’s gonna be like, ‘Oh man, he shouldn’t talk to Luka,” Green said. “You should not talk to Luka. And I disagree with that shit, 1,000%. You fuc*** go and talk to somebody. You talk until you can’t fuc**** talk no more. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “And if he busts your a**, guess what? You play him again three more times, and you go back at his a** again. And then you see him the third time, and you go back at his a** again.” Lendeborg’s frustration with Doncic extended beyond their on-court confrontation. During his postgame press conference, the Warriors rookie made an even stronger statement about the Lakers superstar, claiming that he had lost all respect for the Slovenian guard after playing against him in his first regular-season NBA game. Meanwhile, Warriors superstar Stephen Curry also expressed his support for Lendeborg. “So he’s setting the table for himself to have to show up, and I like that nature of the game, whether you do it in between your ears or you let it out, I know he’ll be able to back it up,” Curry said. Unfortunately for Lendeborg, his NBA debut ended in a loss as the Warriors fell 125-107 to the Lakers. Despite the disappointing team result, the rookie delivered a respectable individual performance, finishing with 12 points on 5-of-11 shooting from the field, along with three rebounds. The 0-1 Warriors will now look to bounce back from their season-opening loss when they take on the Memphis Grizzlies on Friday. Related: Warriors’ Steve Kerr doesn’t hold back on Yaxel Lendeborg, Luka Doncic Related: Lakers’ Luka Doncic sounds off on making Yaxel Lendeborg pay for trash talk

item.title: 'Let's not kid ourselves!' - Bernardo Silva sounds El Clasico alarm as midfielder nets first Real Madrid goal in Champions League rout
item.description: Real Madrid v Sevilla FC - LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Bernardo Silva opened his Real Madrid account during a commanding 4-1 Champions League victory over RB Leipzig. However, the Portuguese midfielder is already turning his attention to a crucial El Clasico showdown against Barcelona. The playmaker stressed that Jose Mourinho's men must refine their tactical balance ahead of a fixture that could dictate the La Liga title race. Silva opens account in commanding Leipzig win Real Madrid secured a 4-1 Champions League triumph over RB Leipzig on matchday three, but the scoreline flattered the hosts following a shaky start. The Bundesliga outfit repeatedly threatened during the opening 45 minutes, forcing Thibaut Courtois into vital interventions to keep his side level. Following the interval, Los Blancos finally clicked into gear. Silva found the net right before the break to register his first goal for the Spanish giants since his summer move from Man City, helping seal a comprehensive European victory. Despite the emphatic result, the playmaker acknowledged that the squad is still searching for tactical harmony as they integrate their array of attacking talent. Striking the perfect tactical balance Speaking to Movistar Plus+ after the final whistle, Bernardo highlighted the struggle of managing a squad packed with individual flair. "It’s difficult to strike a balance between controlling the game and not being a boring team," he explained. "We’re a team with players who are very aggressive individually in one-on-one situations, who like to dribble and find space. We need to strike a balance between keeping possession and pushing forward, being direct. "That balance between controlling the game and not being a boring team, whilst remaining intense and aggressive, is difficult and we have to be very well prepared." Reflecting on his milestone goal and the team's sluggish start, the former Man City midfielder praised his goalkeeper. "I’m very happy to have won this match and scored my first goal in this shirt. It was a difficult match; we were much better in the second half than in the first," Bernardo noted. "In the first half, we let them get into our box quite a few times and Thibaut was crucial." FBL-EUR-C1-REAL MADRID-LEIPZIG Trophies demand a united squad With Real Madrid aiming to compete on all fronts, Bernardo stressed the importance of building collective belief. "It’s good to feel that the team remains confident and is improving. I think we’re improving quite a lot; it’s only the start of the season," he said. "We need to keep winning game by game so that, in the last three or four months, we can be in the running for trophies - which is what this club demands of you." The 32-year-old playmaker also made it clear he is happy to accept whatever role is required. "I’m still working hard. I’m ready to help this club for one, five, ten or ninety minutes. item.title: Rams’ Davante Adams holding off on hamstring surgery until ‘best time,’ per Sean McVay
item.description: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images Rams’ Davante Adams holding off on hamstring surgery until ‘best time,’ per Sean McVay appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Los Angeles Rams ’ season is quickly spiralling out of control. Pegged as the top contender to win the Super Bowl this year, Los Angeles’ season is in danger of dying before the halfway point of the season. They are 2-4 after six games and currently sit at the bottom of their division. It’s safe to say that this isn’t where the Rams expected to be at this point of the season. To make matters worse, one of their star players will be out for a meaningful time due to an injury. Star wide receiver Davante Adams suffered a ruptured hamstring in Week 6 and is now out for an extended period of time. Adams has already undergone surgery to repair his hamstring. According to Rams head coach Sean McVay, though, Adams will need an extra procedure. “Sean McVay said Davante Adams will need a “cleanup” procedure on his hamstring but it has not been scheduled yet.” Sarah Barshop reported on X. “‘I think they’re going to give it a couple days and figure out exactly when is the best time,’ McVay said.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Adams’ injury is just the latest addition to the long list of injuries and troubles that the Rams have been dealing with this season. They have already played the majority of the 2026 season without Myles Garrett, who underwent knee surgery earlier this year. They’ve also dealt with other injuries this season, but Garrett’s and Adams’ injuries are the most consequential of them all. Even when they were completely healthy, though, the Rams have been struggling. Adams suffered the injury in their Week 6 game against the Cardinals, but the Los Angeles offense was already struggling before that injury happened. A combination of special teams mishaps and stagnation on offense has led to this supposed superteam struggling to generate any momentum this year. The Rams have a chance to bounce back in Week 7 against the Las Vegas Raiders. On paper, the Rams should be a better team. However, this better team on paper has struggled to put away teams as of late. Can the shorthanded team bounce back? Related: Matthew Stafford shares eye-opening take amid Rams’ injury crisis Related: Rams’ defense dealt another blow with latest IR move

item.description: MIAMI, FLORIDA - OCTOBER 21: Anthony Edwards #5 of the Minnesota Timberwolves reacts against the Miami Heat during the second half at Kaseya Center on October 21, 2026 in Miami, Florida. Edwards scored 45 points and was visibly talking trash to Heat players all night to remind them of his greatness. The Minnesota Timberwolves won the game by 25 points to show a dominant effort and boost their momentum to start the NBA season. Edwards shared after the game that a loud Heat player inspired him to dominate and talk trash all night: “I think it kind of crunk me up. He was talking pretty crazy. When I start talking to him, he didn’t really have too much more to say. I don’t really like that. If you gonna talk s**t, keep talking s**t. Don’t get quiet.” Edwards didn’t reveal which Miami bench player got on his nerves, but he wanted to make it clear that it mattered. Both Edwards and LaMelo Ball both looked outstanding in their first official game together for this new era of Minnesota basketball. Giannis Antetokounmpo and the rest of Miami could not slow down Edwards. The game saw the Timberwolves pulling away in the second quarter and blowing out the Heat by the third quarter. Edwards used Minnesota’s road opener to make a statement to that Heat player and the rest of the league. Which Miami Heat Player Upset Anthony Edwards? item.title: Arteta gives depressing Saka injury update
item.description: Arteta gives depressing Saka injury update Bukayo Saka lasted only 10 minutes of Arsenal’s Champions League draw at Bayern Munich, with Mikel Arteta offering a worrying assessment afterwards. Photo by Leonhard Simon/Getty Images Arsenal fans are facing an anxious wait after Bukayo Saka suffered a quadriceps injury during Arsenal’s 2-2 Champions League draw away to Bayern Munich , with Mikel Arteta admitting afterwards that the problem “doesn’t look good at all”. Saka lasted only 10 minutes at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday night before being forced off with an injury to his left thigh. There was no challenge involved. The winger went down immediately after playing a pass and grabbed his thigh just above the knee before receiving treatment on the pitch. He was unable to continue and headed down the tunnel after Eberechi Eze replaced him, with the match still goalless at that point. Photo by Leonhard Simon/Getty Images Arteta confirmed after the game that the injury was to Saka’s quadriceps rather than his hamstring. “It’s his quad,” Arteta said . “It was early in the game, and the level of intensity his game requires is something incredible. The quality, strength and attention you need has to be at the highest level, and those things happen unfortunately. It doesn’t look good at all, but we have to wait and see.” The Arsenal manager offered little reassurance when speaking separately to TNT Sports . “They are a bit concerned,” he said. “A player who has to come off with a really sharp pain is never good news but we have to wait and see.” Arsenal are now waiting for a further assessment before they can establish how long Saka might be unavailable. Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images

item.title: Bayern coach Kompany doesn't expect long Díaz and Kim absence
item.description: Bayern Munich's Luis Diaz leaves the field during the Champions League soccer match between FC Bayern Munich and Arsenal at the Allianz Arena. (is associated with: «Bayern coach Kompany doesn't expect long Díaz and Kim absence») Sven Hoppe/dpa Bayern Munich winger Luis Díaz and defender Kim Minjae are not expected to be sidelined for a long time as coach Vincent Kompany suggested they could be back for next week's big Bundesliga match against Borussia Dortmund. "I hope it is similar time-wise for both. That means not so long, maybe less than a week," Kompany said after Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw with Arsenal. Medical examinations were to follow but Kompany said "I believe that very severe injuries can be ruled out." Kim started against Arsenal despite not being fully fit and lasted only the first half. Díaz, who did not start owing to muscular problems, came on in the 68th but was substituted again late in the game. The match against Dortmund is on October 31. Before that comes Sunday's match at third-placed Freiburg which Díaz and Kim are set to miss. Champions Bayern top the table on goal difference ahead of Dortmund, with Freiburg and Bayer Leverkusen one point behind.

item.title: Santos grab sixth straight victory after defeating Pumas in controversial fashion
item.description: TORREON, MEXICO - OCTOBER 21: Eduardo Aguirre of Santos celebrates after scoring the first goal of his team during the Liga MX Torneo Apertura 2026 13th-round match between Santos Laguna and Pumas at Corona Stadium on October 21, 2026 in Torreon, Mexico. (Photo by Manuel Guadarrama/Getty Images) | Getty Images Santos Laguna won their sixth straight match for the first time in short tournaments after defeating Pumas by a 2-0 score. In a match filled with controversy from the first minute of play, Santos got a victory that now has them a single point from getting into the Liguilla zone. Santos will have a tough match to try to continue their streak when they travel west to face Tijuana while Pumas will host Tigres in a match where both teams look likely to miss out on the post season. The first half started with Pumas having the return of Cesar Huerta to the starting 11 after being suspended in their last match against Atlante. Less than a minute into the match, Pumas got caught in a counter and Ezequiel Bullaude got into the area where Nathan seemed to have tripped him and the referee gave a Penalty Kick to Santos and gave red card to Nathan, leaving Pumas with 10 players. Replays showed the push had been minimal and it was no way a red card offense, even with the supposed being a clear goal opportunity but the controversial call stood. Eduardo Aguirre stepped up to take the PK and got off a right footed shot past Pumas’ goalkeeper, Keylor Navas to score and give Santos the 1-0 lead. Off a corner kick, the cross into the area was volleyed wide by Diego Gonzalez. Because of injury, Santos subbed out Efrain Orona for Jonathan Perez. Huerta would get into the area and get off a left footed shot that forced a good save from Santos’ goalkeeper, Carlos Acevedo. Santos kept dominating possession but created few chances while Pumas sat back and defended. The halftime whistle blew as Santos looked incredibly cautious for a match at home with a man advantage. The 2nd half started with Santos subbing out Diego Gonzalez for Emmanuel Echeverria. A couple of minutes into the half, Pumas had to sub out an injured Adalberto Carrasquilla for Victor Arteaga. A rabona cross from Huerta turned into a shot that was saved by Acevedo. A free kick into the area was headed by Uriel Antuna directly to Acevedo. Santos subbed out Tahiel Jimenez and Fran Villalba for Esteban Lozano and Aldo Lopez. A run into the area ended with a cross by Mauricio Cuevas that turned into a shot that Navas saved. Pumas subbed out Rodrigo Lopez for Alvaro Angulo. In the ensuing corner kick, the cross into the area was headed by Felipe Sanchez and Ruben Duarte would handle the ball and the referee will give another PK to Santos. Franco Pardo took the PK and got off a right footed shot past Navas to score and give Santos the 2-0 lead. Santos subbed out Eduardo Aguirre for Luis Gomez. Eduardo Aguirre stepped up to take the PK and got off a right footed shot past Pumas’ goalkeeper, Keylor Navas to score and give Santos the 1-0 lead. Off a corner kick, the cross into the area was volleyed wide by Diego Gonzalez. Because of injury, Santos subbed out Efrain Orona for Jonathan Perez. Huerta would get into the area and get off a left footed shot that forced a good save from Santos’ goalkeeper, Carlos Acevedo. Santos kept dominating possession but created few chances while Pumas sat back and defended. The halftime whistle blew as Santos looked incredibly cautious for a match at home with a man advantage. The 2nd half started with Santos subbing out Diego Gonzalez for Emmanuel Echeverria. A couple of minutes into the half, Pumas had to sub out an injured Adalberto Carrasquilla for Victor Arteaga. A rabona cross from Huerta turned into a shot that was saved by Acevedo. A free kick into the area was headed by Uriel Antuna directly to Acevedo. Santos subbed out Tahiel Jimenez and Fran Villalba for Esteban Lozano and Aldo Lopez. A run into the area ended with a cross by Mauricio Cuevas that turned into a shot that Navas saved. Pumas subbed out Rodrigo Lopez for Alvaro Angulo. In the ensuing corner kick, the cross into the area was headed by Felipe Sanchez and Ruben Duarte would handle the ball and the referee will give another PK to Santos. Franco Pardo took the PK and got off a right footed shot past Navas to score and give Santos the 2-0 lead. Santos subbed out Eduardo Aguirre for Luis Gomez. A counter ended with a cross into the area where eventually Lozano would get off a right footed shot that went wide. Pumas subbed out Juninho and Pablo Bennevendo for Santiago Lopez and Antonio Leone. There was a huge scuffle between the benches of both sides that included punches and fan’s from the stands throwing beer at Pumas’ players. Apparently it started when Juninho came out of the match taunting the stands and ended with a Pumas coach getting red carded. The match ended and Santos made team history with their sixth straight victory. Santos made team history by getting their sixth straight win although the match was lackluster and marked by controversy. The first minute PK decision that left Pumas down to 10 players (a later down to 1-0) meant that Pumas had an uphill climb they never where able to overcome. Santos had a huge advantage and yet they failed to take much advantage, giving a very average performance. Still it was good enough to get the victory and climb to 9th place. They will have a very tough match to try to continue the streak as they play against Xolos in Tijuana. Pumas, who seem like they are out of post season play, will host another disappointing team in Tigres.

item.title: Stephen A. Smith says he already knows when LeBron James is going to retire
item.description: Photo by Aaron M. Sprecher/Getty Images LeBron James just started his 24th season in the NBA. The basketball icon, who is the GOAT in some people’s eyes, extended his own record when he played for the Philadelphia 76ers in their season opener against the New York Knicks. James is taking things season by season at the moment and has made no announcement about when he plans on retiring. But Stephen A. Smith thinks he knows when that will be. Stephen A. Smith says LeBron James will retire after his 25th season Smith and James have had their conflicts over the years, but what nobody can deny is their deep love for basketball. The TV personality always has something to say about the games he watches, and it was no different after the Sixers beat the Knicks on the opening night. James’ debut was always going to be a hot topic of discussion, and Smith admitted on ESPN that he really liked seeing The King play as a center. Using that, the presenter has come up with a theory on when James is going to retire. He said: “I love the role that LeBron played and his willingness to be that big guy that’s defending other bigs. “He has gotten big, as you can see, because he recognises the fact that he’s going to be spending most of his time at the four-to-five position playing for this particular team. So, I get that part. “And because he’s in his 24th season, age 42 (actually 41), these are the last two years of his career. He’s going to play a quarter century. That’s the goal. Play 25 years and then walk away, retire. “You know that he’s not trying to be out there every night running up and down the court. That’s not what he’s going to do.” Retiring after 25 years at the top would be an exceptional achievement, but James has not closed the door on playing for another year. “When I’m done, will it be 24 years? 25 years? 26 years? Who knows? We’ll see when I’m finished,” James said earlier in 2026. item.title: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs in AI-led efficiency drive
item.description: Barclays has revealed it is cutting 5,000 jobs - 5% of its workforce - as part of efforts to save costs and drive efficiency through investment in artificial intelligence (AI).

item.title: Today's 5️⃣: Madrid run riot, Betis win and Boca learn their opponents
item.description: Today's 5️⃣: Madrid run riot, Betis win and Boca learn their opponents Good morning, football fans. The third round of Champions League matches wrapped up yesterday, and there’s plenty to talk about at home and abroad. Here are the day’s top 5 stories. Let’s get started. Real Madrid cruise to emphatic win over Leipzig Los Blancos enjoyed a brilliant night in Europe with a convincing victory over RB Leipzig. They controlled the game from the opening whistle and were ruthlessly effective in attack. The tactical game plan worked to perfection on the pitch. Their high press repeatedly forced the German side to give the ball away, allowing the home attackers to pose a constant threat. 📸 Diego Souto - 2026 Getty Images The win gives Real Madrid a confidence boost heading into El Clásico next Sunday, October 25. Betis beat Feyenoord and keep making history Betis still have a perfect record in the Champions League. Manuel Pellegrini ’s men edged past Feyenoord thanks to an Isco penalty and continue to dream big. 📸 JORGE GUERRERO - AFP or licensors The road ahead is tough, but not impossible: Dortmund, Slovan Bratislava, Como, Arsenal and Bayern. The build-up to El Clásico heats up This Sunday’s El Clásico at Spotify Camp Nou will have plenty of talking points, including José Mourinho’s return to Barcelona. The clash between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid will also be marked by tensions between the clubs’ leadership: Florentino Pérez will not travel to Barcelona, so there will be no reunion with Joan Laporta. 📸 Angel Martinez - 2025 Getty Images Real Sociedad and Celta de Vigo prepare for European action A demanding day awaits Spain’s representatives in Europe. Real Sociedad and Celta de Vigo are putting the finishing touches to their preparations for this afternoon’s UEFA Europa League fixtures. Both teams are chasing their first win in the competition: Matarazzo’s side have one point, while Claudio Giráldez’s men have none. Atlético Mineiro reach Sudamericana final; Palmeiras reach Libertadores final The finalists in South America’s two continental competitions are taking shape. Atlético Mineiro booked their place in the Copa Sudamericana final after edging past Montevideo City Torque 3-2 on aggregate. The final is now confirmed: Boca Juniors vs Atlético Mineiro in Barranquilla. 📸 Ernesto Ryan - 2026 Getty Images Meanwhile, the Copa Libertadores clash between Palmeiras and Fluminense went down to the wire, with the Verdão securing their place in the final in a penalty shootout. Palmeiras await the winner of today’s meeting between Flamengo and Estudiantes. This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇪🇸 here.

item.title: IND vs NZ 1st T20I 2026 live scorecard, toss winner, winning probability, result and highlights from Christchurch
item.description: IND vs NZ 1st T20I 2026 live scorecard, toss winner, winning probability, result and highlights from Christchurch originally appeared on Cricket News . Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . KEY MATCH DETAILS: (New Zealand vs. India 1st T20I) Venue: Hagley Oval, Christchurch Captains: Mitchell Santner ( New Zealand ), Shreyas Iyer ( India ) Toss result: India won the toss and chose to field first. Live Telecast: Sony Sports Network and SonyLIV (India), Sky Sport (New Zealand) Umpires and match officials: Chris Brown and Shaun Haig (on-field umpires), Kim Cotton (TV umpire), Cory Black (reserve umpire), and Ranjan Madugalle (match referee) Match result: To be confirmed Player of the Match: To be confirmed FOLLOW LIVE: Ball-by-ball updates of the match New Zealand vs. India 1st T20I live match scorecard Follow along with the latest live scorecard here as the match unfolds, or click here for key text commentary updates from the action. New Zealand vs. India 1st T20I Live Score & Updates Welcome to CricketNews.com's live coverage of the first T20I between New Zealand and India at Hagley Oval in Christchurch. India batting updates: 6 overs: New Zealand 65/1 (Allen 33, Mitchell 7) New Zealand ended the Powerplay on a high, racing to 65/1 after 6 overs against India. Finn Allen spearheaded the charge, launching Axar Patel for a towering six over long-off to bring up his 33 off 17 balls. Daryl Mitchell got in on the act immediately after coming to the crease, stepping down the track to loft Axar for a massive six of his own over long-on. Despite losing Tim Seifert for a quickfire 24, New Zealand's aggressive approach has put them firmly in the driver's seat at the end of the fielding restrictions. Toss result: India won the toss and chose to field first. Pre-match: These two sides have not met since the T20 World Cup final in March, when India won by 96 runs, and New Zealand fancy their chances of redressing that in conditions they know far better. Hagley Oval offers seam movement and bounce, and forecasts predict the evening temperature will fall towards 14°C by the closing overs. India arrive jetlagged, with no real acclimatisation time and without Jasprit Bumrah or Hardik Pandya. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back in the squad for the first time since November 2022, and Varun Chakaravarthy returns from the injury that sidelined him at the Asian Games. Their last assignment, a home series against the West Indies, ended 2-2 after rain washed out the Bengaluru decider. New Zealand have their own problems to deal with. Rachin Ravindra is out with a dislocated shoulder, while Mark Chapman and Zak Foulkes were ruled out earlier this month. Michael Bracewell and Adam Milne are both back from injury, and Finn Allen and Tim Seifert are expected to reunite at the top of the order. History favours the visitors despite the conditions. India have won each of their last two bilateral T20I series in New Zealand and lead the head-to-head 19-11 from 31 match

item.description: New Zealand host India in the opening T20I of a five-match series at Hagley Oval on Thursday, October 22. It is the start of a 12-match tour that runs through to December 1. There is an obvious edge to the fixture. The last time these sides met, India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the T20 World Cup final in March, and Mitchell Santner's team will not have forgotten how comprehensively that night went against them. MAKE YOUR BET WITH DAFABET AND GET UP TO 200% WELCOME BONUS India are without Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya, while New Zealand have lost Rachin Ravindra to a dislocated shoulder along with Mark Chapman and Zak Foulkes, which has thinned out both attacks before a ball has been bowled. Conditions could be the decisive factor at a ground India have never played a men's T20I on. The evening is forecast to stay dry but cold, with temperatures dropping towards 14°C by the closing overs. Live scorecard New Zealand vs. India 1st T20I: Live updates and toss result New Zealand batting updates After 6 overs, New Zealand are 65/1 New Zealand made full use of the Powerplay, putting India's bowling attack under relentless pressure from the start. Tim Seifert and Finn Allen took on Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Arshdeep Singh, boundaries flowing freely despite some early lateral movement. Mayank Yadav provided India's sole breakthrough in the fifth over, using his express pace to get Seifert (24) caught behind by Sanju Samson. However, the momentum stayed with the hosts as Allen (33*) and Mitchell (7*) closed out the sixth over with a 16-run assault against Axar Patel. The Brazilian was decisive again, winning a game that went uphill after Bastoni’s red card (1-0). Milan and Juve, the 9 test Ramos injured; Cisse starts against Bournemouth. Game uphill: Bastoni sent off for naivety. The Brazilian scores in the final minutes, his fourth-season goal. Golden Mkhitaryan assist. Pep Martinez is decisive. Como United The genius is Cesc: A historic club with 68 trophies is crushed, 4-1. Nico dismantles Manchester Fabregas blasts Carrick. Paz phenomenon: brace and artist coups. Then Frosinone, Fiorentina and Parma to forget about a disappointing start. Tuttosport Crazy Como Historic feat: 4-1 to United, who accelerate for Conte Nico Paz’s brace, with the Como star now a European sensation, plus goals from Douvikas and Ramón, send the Lariani fans into ecstasy and could even lead to Carrick’s sacking. Decisive substitutions and Mkhitaryan: a fantastic assist for the Brazilian’s fourth-season goal. Toro, Cholito: ‘We feel the fans’ energy.’ Ramos injured: here’s Cisse to launch the EuroMilan Besides the Portuguese (calf), Chukwueze is out too. The Azzurrino starts up front. He’s the best Rossoneri scorer and wants to celebrate his 20th birthday with a goal.

item.title: Tresoldi has time to decide international future, insists Klopp
item.description: Tresoldi has time to decide international future, insists Klopp Jürgen Klopp has described Nicolo Tresoldi as a “world-class talent” following the striker’s hat-trick against Inter Milan a week ago, but has urged caution over the debate surrounding his international future. Tresoldi’s impressive performance has intensified interest in which national team he will ultimately represent. However, Klopp believes that the attention should not become a burden for the young forward as he considers such an important decision. “Tresoldi is a world-class talent, but there is no point putting pressure on the lad because of his decision about which national team he wants to play for,” Klopp said. The Germany coach stressed that Tresoldi is currently involved with the under-21 team and has time to decide what is best for his future. “He is with the under-21s for now and has time. But yes, he has outstanding qualities, and we want to give him the peace and space he needs to make this important decision.” With his performances attracting growing attention, Tresoldi’s international future is likely to remain a talking point. For now, however, Klopp wants the youngster to concentrate on his development and make his choice in his own time.

item.title: Kano will vote Tinubu in 2027, Yusuf assures
item.description: By Hadiza Yusuf Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has assured President Bola Tinubu of the support of Kano residents in the 2027 general election, expressing confidence that they will vote for the President to ensure the continuation of his development projects. Yusuf spoke on Wednesday while representing Tinubu at the commissioning of a section of the Abuja-Kaduna-Zaria-Kano Highway at Tamburawa, Kano State. He praised the President for projects being executed by the Federal Government, saying the highway would ease transportation across Northern Nigeria. The governor also said several projects executed by the Tinubu administration had not received adequate publicity. “I have seen many projects the President has executed that have not been publicised. I could go on and on listing the projects and initiatives of this administration,” Yusuf said. He expressed confidence that residents of Kano and other parts of the country would support Tinubu in the next general election. “The people of Kano will come out en masse to vote for President Tinubu, not only in Kano but across the North-West, the South and the country at large, to ensure the continuation of his development projects,” he added. Umahi Says Economic Hardship Easing Also speaking at the event, the Minister of Works, David Umahi, said the worst of Nigeria’s economic hardship was over, insisting that the Tinubu administration’s reforms were beginning to yield positive results. “The reforms have started to yield dividends of democracy. Even in the darkest hour before dawn, there is hope. Let us support President Bola Tinubu,” Umahi said. He cited road projects in Kano and other parts of the North-West as evidence of the administration’s efforts, adding that the Federal Government was working to complete projects inherited from the late President Muhammadu Buhari. “There is no project started by the late President Buhari that President Bola Tinubu is not doing in the North,” he said. Umahi listed several road projects in the region, including the Kano Northern Bypass, Kano Ring Road, Kano-Kongolam road and Zaria-Hunkuyi road projects. He also said the Federal Government was working on the Sokoto-Zamfara-Zaria road. According to the minister, some inherited projects have been redesigned to feature reinforced concrete pavement. Umahi said the Tinubu administration had completed close to 400 kilometres of roads in the North-West within three years, while about 4,000 kilometres of road projects were ongoing in the region. He added that the Abuja-Kaduna-Zaria-Kano Highway would benefit not only the North-West but also other parts of the country. The post Kano will vote Tinubu in 2027, Yusuf assures appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: North-South Power Rotation Fundamental For National Unity — Akume
item.description: The Secretary to the Government of the Federation (SGF), Senator George Akume, has reiterated the need for political stakeholders to respect the power rotation arrangement between Northern and Southern Nigeria, describing it as a fundamental understanding that has sustained national cohesion, fairness and the growth of democracy since the return to civilian rule in 1999. The SGF made the call while receiving a delegation from the Order of the Knights of St. Mulumba (KSM) Nigeria, led by its Supreme Knight, Sir Steve Adehi, on Wednesday in Abuja, according to a statement by his Head, Information & Public Relations, Chris Ugwuegbulam. He recalled that the agreement was reached in Kaduna in 1999 following extensive consultations between governors-elect on the platform of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) and prominent political leaders who recognised the need for equitable distribution of political power to preserve Nigeria’s unity. Akume said the leaders eventually agreed that presidential power should alternate between the North and the South in eight-year cycles, beginning with the South, as a practical measure to promote political balance, strengthen mutual trust and safeguard the country’s territorial integrity. According to him, the discussions were driven by concerns over the concentration of political power in one part of the country and the growing dissatisfaction among stakeholders who believed that a deliberate arrangement was necessary to ensure fairness and national inclusion. The SGF noted that the arrangement has contributed to the continuity of democratic governance by providing a framework for managing the country’s regional diversity and ensuring that neither part of the country feels permanently excluded from the highest political office. He stressed that the principle of power rotation should not be treated as a temporary political convenience but as an important political understanding rooted in the need for fairness, mutual respect and national stability. Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Sen. George Akume, CON, (6th right), Permanent Secretary, Cabinet Affairs Office, Dr. John Chidiebere Ezeamama, (5th right), Supreme Knight of the Knight of Saint Mulumba, Sir Steve Adehi (7th right) and other members of the Knights of Saint Mulumba and some staff/aides of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation in a group photograph during the courtesy visit of the Knights to the SGF on Wednesday, 21st October, 2026 in Abuja. Akume also frowned at attempts by Northern aspirants to contest the presidency before the completion of the South’s current eight-year tenure, insisting that the North should respect the established sequence and allow the arrangement to run its course. He maintained that, following the eight years of former President Muhammadu Buhari’s administration, of blessed memory, a Southerner’s current tenure should be respected in line with the principle of alternating power between the two regions.
